summary: Stop shipping the Module Federation runtime once per remote (~67 kB per app entry)
description:
Background
Every frontend module's remote entry currently embeds its own copy of the Module Federation runtime (@module-federation/runtime-core + sdk, ~67 kB of each ~85 kB entry). Measured on the reference application, MF machinery totals 456 kB on the login page and 607 kB on the home page — 11–13% of all JavaScript fetched. The genuinely per-app portion (container module map + share-scope metadata) is only ~15–18 kB; the runtime itself is identical across remotes and should ship once.
Requested change
Investigate and enable federation-runtime hoisting/sharing in the shared rspack config (e.g. the ModuleFederation runtime experiments/options in current rspack / module-federation releases) so the runtime is provided once (by the app shell) and remotes reference it, rather than each embedding a copy. Apply the equivalent in the shared webpack config, or document the divergence if webpack has no equivalent mechanism.
Acceptance criteria
Remote entry size reduction measured and recorded on a representative assembled distribution (expected: roughly 67 kB per remote entry).

A page load fetches the federation runtime once, not once per app (verify via network trace / source-map attribution).

Remotes built with the previous tooling still load correctly alongside new ones (mixed-version distribution verified).

Build-level test or CI check in the tooling package guarding against the runtime reappearing in remote entries.
